messages:
tia: Heads up 5: prepping a docs patch to refresh SDK snippets: streaming iterator shape, pagination token rename, and the retries field rename. Will touch quickstart + migration guide + examples.

maria: Nice. Can you list the exact renames so I can update wording in migration.md?

tia: Sure: request param `page_token` -> `cursor_token`; responses now give `next_cursor` (was `cursor`). Retry config renamed `retry_policy` -> `retries` with shape { attempts, backoff_ms? }. Streaming: Python/TS expose async iterators; Go uses a Next() pull loop. No behavioral change to retry semantics.

sam: I'll update the TypeScript quickstart. Suggestion: keep inline snippets tiny and link to full examples for error handling/backpressure.

jon: For the Python sample I want to show a tiny buffering pattern so users don't print partial tokens mid-word. Proposed quick example (compact):

```python
buffer = ""
async for token in client.stream.generate(model="rwd-1-stream", prompt=prompt, retries={"attempts":2}):
    buffer += token.text
    if buffer.endswith("\n") or buffer.endswith("."):
        print(buffer, end="")
        buffer = ""
```

jon: Add a short note: streams may emit partial tokens; buffer if you need sentence/line granularity.

maria: Good. Also add how to catch terminal stream errors (StreamError) and fallback to sync.generate. One-liner is fine.

tia: For Go I'll include an explicit context cancel example and show io.EOF handling. Minimal snippet in quickstart, full pattern in examples/streaming-go.md.

sam: TS snippet for quickstart: `for await (const tok of client.stream.generate({ model: 'rwd-1-stream', prompt, retries: { attempts: 3 } })) { process.stdout.write(tok.text) }` — I'll make it a one-liner block in the quickstart. Also add an inline comment about idempotency when retrying paginated requests.

dev-doc-bot: note: please update the SDK reference table to mark quantized model variants with a footnote: "streaming decode latency may be higher on quantized variants".

maria: After patches land I'll review. Aim for <=8 lines in quickstart snippets and link to expanded examples for error/backpressure/batching.
